plan.title: Python lists in two steps
plan.summary: Build a list with append, then ask it how long it is.

segments.text: Start with an empty list called words. Now append the word apple. Then append the word pear.
segments.predict: If we print the length of words now, what number appears?

segments.text: Now print the length of words. It prints two, because each append adds exactly one item.
